lines.text: As I stop by the dorms to retrieve the things I need,
I find Noir and Blanc hanging out at the front of the building.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Recently we've been feeling a bit tired,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: but today it really feels like we're running on empty.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I've never seen you struggle this much before.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: It's my first time feeling like this as well...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: There was one other time before when I felt like this when I was with Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: All I had to do then was get a good night's sleep, and I was right as rain.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Do you know what caused it?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: but I think it was because I was a bit too free with giving my luck out to him.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I've had some bad luck recently.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: So it's been the same for you?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I've felt a bit off as of late.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Pit Boss, can you give me your hand?
I tentatively reach out my hand,
and both Blanc and Noir grasp onto it firmly.
Normally, I would have felt a pleasant tingling sensation,
but this time, I don't feel anything.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I first started to sense that something was unusual

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: when I saw you at the hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Slipping and falling are the type of unlucky incidents

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: yet I took a big spill back there at the hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It was at that moment that I knew something was amiss.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: It was a similar thing for me.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I felt it when I saw you in the bamboo forest.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: When I saw my note come loose, I felt that something was different.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I know for a fact that I secured it tightly, yet it came fluttering down as if it had a mind of its own.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I can't recall ever experiencing something like that.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: If I'm being honest, the Lucky Hot Spring event was a bit challenging for me as well.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Same! I had a tough time that day too.
Blanc and Noir are in a real pickle.
It appears that, for reasons unknown, their luck has somehow been drained.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: This could all have something to do with the hot spring?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Yes, there's the legend about luck coming when ■■ enter the hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: That's why I was so dead set on figuring out the concrete details. No matter what I did though, I couldn't get it to work.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: On top of that, when you factor in the Lucky Hot Spring event...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: If that hot spring can bring you luck,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: do you think it's possible that it could also take it away?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Don't you think that's a little far-fetched?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Neither of us has experienced anything like this before.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Okay, I'll concede that it's possible.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: But before we get too carried away, let's get some rest.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: If we don't see any improvement in our condition...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Then we'll need to find out the secret of the hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We've got to find a way to replenish our luck, and if the hot spring could potentially help us with that, we need to look into it.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: if it comes down to that, will you be willing to help us?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We appreciate the help, Pit Boss.
Don't mention it. For now, you two go and get some rest.
As I help tuck the exhausted Blanc and Noir into bed,
If this is indeed a hot spring that robs people of their luck,
it'd be more apt to consider it a curse than a legend.
While I'm looking around the Snowfield, I find Blanc and Noir at the walking trail.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I wouldn't exactly say we're doing well.
They both still look to be in rough shape.
It's clear that their condition hasn't improved at all just by taking a brief rest.
What are you doing out here? How come you're not resting?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We're on our way to the hot spring.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Maybe this is all happening because we tried to act before we fully understood how it works.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: What else do you know about that place? Anything at all.
To be honest, I don't know all that much about it.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: If things continue in this vein,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: and our luck doesn't come back,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: we'll no longer be the lucky bunnies...
The atmosphere suddenly takes a sullen turn.
A heavy silence falls over all of us, as none of us know what to say. Just then...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I heard you two weren't feeling too well.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Are you sure it's a good idea to be out and about like this?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: If you need anything, just say the word.
Ludmilla, would you happen to know anything about the legends associated with the hot spring?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Ludmilla, you probably know the most about Snowfield Hot Spring!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Can we ask for your help?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Is there anything you could possibly tell us?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: We know it has something to do with entering the hot spring, yes?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: But about who can go in,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: and who you enter with are all of vital importance.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: There are too many factors at play to try and succeed using dumb luck.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Yes, this would be quite the challenge, even for someone like the lucky bunnies.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: There's nothing wrong with our luck at all, thank you very much. It's just that we don't have all the facts.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Oh, my apologies. I didn't mean to disparage your skills.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'm sorry if it came across that way.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: No, we're the ones who should apologize.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We've just been a bit on edge, that's all.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: So, is there anything you can tell us?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: there's nothing I can tell you with complete certainty,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: but there are a few points and conjectures I can share with you.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: This hot spring was once a family-run business.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Sorry, I know that's not much help.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: No no, it's a big help!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Thanks to you, we have something to go on.
You're not going to the hot spring right now, are you?
You shouldn't overexert yourselves. You still need more rest.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: In your current state, you'll only make things worse if you push yourselves.
Blanc and Noir are unable to hide their anxiety, which is painfully palpable.
I tenderly clasp both of their hands in mine.
I'll go with you two then.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: That's a relief if you accompany them.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: But still, don't push yourselves too much.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Thank you, Ludmilla, and Pit Boss.
I try my best to hide my utter confusion.
Hand-in-hand, the three of us leave and head towards the hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Thanks to Ludmilla, we've got a clue, however tiny.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Family is the operative word here,

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: so we will become a family.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It's when you enter the hot spring as a family that you receive good luck!
But you two are family, and you said nothing happened when you both went in.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: So we can say with confidence that it doesn't work with sisters alone.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We have to try and match the composition of the family who used to run the hot spring.
But you two are the only ones actually related to each other.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: B-but didn't we explain this before?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We decided that you were the dad, and we were the mom.
Are you sure playacting is the way out of this situation?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We'll start with a regular couple.
There are so many logical gaps in this plan, that I don't even know where to start.
What about our clothes? Aren't we going to get wet?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We'll bring a change of clothes later,
Is it okay for men and women to enter the hot spring together?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: and she said this side of the hot spring is for both men and women.
Since a couple usually consists of just two people, shouldn't only one of you come in with me?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I think we should all go in together as one couple.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: then it'd naturally be the same for Blanc.
I don't think the owner of Snowfield had multiple partners.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I guess we have no choice then.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Who do you want to go in with?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: ... I can't say this is how I wanted it to go, but I guess I have no choice.
I step into the hot spring along with Blanc.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I have to say, being in the hot spring together with you feels a bit strange.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Do you feel like your luck has been recharged?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Actually, on second thought, I don't feel any different.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Maybe we all have to go in together?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: ... I can't say this is how I wanted it to go, but I guess I have no choice.
I step into the hot spring along with Noir.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: being in the hot spring together with you feels a bit strange.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Do you feel like your luck has been recharged?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Actually, on second thought, I don't feel any different.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Maybe we all have to go in together?
It appears that all three of us have to take a dip inside the hot spring.
Surely there must be a way to get out of this...
Maybe we're missing some family members?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We need someone to play the part of a child?
We step out of the hot spring and start putting our heads together.
Would she be comfortable with that?
How about one of you play the role of the child?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We're both the wife. If I have to be the child, then Noir has to do the same.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We're both the wife. If I have to be the child, then Blanc has to do the same.
I suddenly see Lumi off to the side, craning her neck towards the hot spring.
I'm unsure how long she's been there watching.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Lumi, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: ... Never mind. If you're not busy, can you help us out?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Are you sure about this, Blanc?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Can you help us, pretty please?
At first, Lumi seems somewhat skeptical,
but she eventfully approaches us, albeit cautiously.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: do you know anything special about the legends surrounding this hot spring?
When we had originally gone to investigate the dorm, we all reached one conclusion:
Lumi and this place were connected in some way.
Although I'm worried about how she'll react if we ask her these types of questions so directly,
my curiosity is at an all-time high, so I stand back and observe Lumi's reaction.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We're curious as to precisely how you can obtain luck from going into this hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Did you just call us your sisters?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: if you know any secrets about the hot spring, you can tell your sisters.
Without uttering a word, Lumi grasps Blanc and Noir's hands
and proceeds towards the hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Do you want to go into the hot spring?
Blanc and Noir head into the hot spring first,
followed not long after by Lumi, who gingerly dips her feet into the water.
Hearing the frantic tone in Blanc's voice,
I quickly enter the hot spring.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I felt something a moment ago, I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: The moment Pit Boss came in, the feeling disappeared...

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: So that makes me the older sister!
As Lumi stares at Noir, her expression grows increasingly more serious.
She tightens her grip on Blanc's hand and leads her out of the hot spring.
As Noir approaches Lumi and Blanc,
Lumi lets go of Blanc's hand and runs off.
No, you didn't do anything wrong.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I'm not sure what just happened, but I know one thing for sure.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: If we want to get to the bottom of this mystery,
After today's events, we all determined conclusively
that Lumi held the key to unraveling this legend.
